tasks.title: Project skeleton and dependency setup
tasks.description: Stand up the Python project: virtualenv, requirements.txt (faster-whisper with CUDA, audio + UI deps), app entry point, and a smoke test that imports the package and asserts the entry point is callable.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh environment installs from requirements.txt
Entry point launches without error
Smoke test passes

tasks.title: Audio device enumeration and launch-time picker
tasks.description: Enumerate available WASAPI loopback-capable output devices and present a picker at launch so the user selects which device to listen from before capture starts.
acceptance_criteria: Lists loopback-capable devices with stable identifiers
Picker returns the chosen device to the caller
Device enumeration is unit-tested with the audio backend mocked

tasks.title: WASAPI loopback capture stream
tasks.description: Capture system audio from the selected device via WASAPI loopback and feed PCM frames into a thread-safe queue for the ASR consumer.
acceptance_criteria: Captures loopback audio from the selected device into a frame queue
Capture runs on its own thread and can be started/stopped cleanly
Frame format (rate/channels/dtype) is documented and tested

tasks.title: Real-time Japanese ASR pipeline
tasks.description: Consume audio frames in chunks and run faster-whisper on the GPU to produce Japanese transcripts, emitting partial results quickly and finalized segments as more audio arrives.
acceptance_criteria: Transcribes Japanese audio chunks in near real time on the GPU
Emits partial then finalized segments
Chunking/segmentation logic is unit-tested with the model mocked

tasks.title: Japanese-to-English translation
tasks.description: Translate ASR output to English using Whisper's translate task, behind a pluggable language-pair interface so additional pairs can be added later.
acceptance_criteria: Produces English text from Japanese audio via the translate task
Language-pair selection goes through a documented interface
Interface and JA->EN implementation are unit-tested

tasks.title: Full-screen transparent overlay window
tasks.description: Create a full-screen, fully transparent, click-through, always-on-top overlay window (PySide6) that other widgets render onto without intercepting input to the app underneath.
acceptance_criteria: Window is full-screen, transparent, always-on-top, and click-through
Mouse and keyboard pass through to the application beneath
Window construction is tested headlessly where feasible

tasks.title: Subtitle renderer
tasks.description: Render translated text as subtitles on the overlay with appearance controls (font size, screen position, background opacity) and timing logic that clears stale lines.
acceptance_criteria: Displays translated lines with configurable font size, position, and opacity
Stale lines clear on a defined timing rule
Timing/clearing logic is unit-tested

tasks.title: Auto-hiding settings bar
tasks.description: Add a top-of-screen settings bar that stays hidden and reveals on hover, exposing language pair, subtitle appearance (font size, position, opacity), latency-vs-accuracy model size, and exit.
acceptance_criteria: Bar is hidden by default and appears on hover at the top region
Exposes language pair, font size, position, opacity, model size, and exit
Control state changes emit events the app can subscribe to

tasks.title: Exit controls and clean shutdown
tasks.description: Provide exit from the settings bar and a top-right exit button, and ensure stopping cleanly tears down audio capture and ASR threads.
acceptance_criteria: Exit is reachable from the settings bar and a top-right button
Shutdown stops capture and ASR threads without leaks or hangs
Shutdown sequence is tested

tasks.title: Latency-accuracy wiring and ephemeral settings
tasks.description: Wire the model-size control to the ASR pipeline so the latency-vs-accuracy choice takes effect, and ensure all settings are ephemeral, resetting to defaults on every launch.
acceptance_criteria: Changing model size re-configures the ASR pipeline
No settings persist across launches; defaults are restored each time
Settings defaults and wiring are unit-tested

tasks.title: Package as Windows executable
tasks.description: Package the app as a Windows .exe (PyInstaller), handle model/runtime bundling, and document setup and run steps.
acceptance_criteria: Produces a launchable Windows .exe
Model/runtime bundling strategy is documented
README covers setup and run steps
